core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Luxury Corporate Finance meets Glassmorphism
Content is King: Directed storytelling with data visualization
Zoom In: Bold focus on metrics and financial growth
Negative Space: Generous breathing room (2-3x standard)
Contrast: High contrast Gold vs Deep Obsidian

rules: Body text uses Manrope for readability.
Numbers and financial data use JetBrains Mono or Manrope tabular-nums.
Letter spacing: Tight for headings (-0.02em), Wide for captions (0.1em).

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-semibold px-8 py-4 rounded-none hover:bg-accent transition-colors shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-primary/30 text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 px-8 py-4 rounded-none transition-colors
buttons.glass: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white hover:bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md px-6 py-3 rounded-none

cards.feature: bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 p-8 hover:border-primary/30 transition-all group
cards.stat: bg-gradient-to-br from-white/5 to-transparent border border-white/5 p-6

inputs.default: bg-black/50 border-white/10 focus:border-primary/50 text-white placeholder:text-white/20 h-12 rounded-none

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENT DARK MODE ONLY. Force class='dark' on html/body.
Use 'Montserrat' for all Headings (h1-h6). Import from Google Fonts.
Use 'Manrope' for all Body text. Import from Google Fonts.
Implement Glassmorphism for all cards and dashboards: bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/10.
Primary Color is GOLD (#D4AF37). Use it for CTAs and accents.
Background is Deep Obsidian (#0A0A0A). Never use pure black #000000.
Dashboard Layout: Use a dense Grid. Sidebar + Topbar + Content Area.
Landing Page: Use large typography, gold accents, and the provided abstract gold background image.
Animations: Use Framer Motion for smooth entrances. Stagger children.
Charts: Use Recharts with customized tooltips (dark glass style).
Referral Tree: Use a custom recursive component or a library like 'react-d3-tree' if needed, styled with gold connections.
YouTube Task: Implement a custom timer component (30s) that unlocks the 'Claim' button.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
